headline: Your trade sizing after losses is costing you.

size_up_after_loss.why_it_matters: The cost of this behaviour was ₹1,05,732. It occurred in 96 trades where the median entry size after a loss was ₹12,562 compared with ₹6,578 otherwise, giving a size ratio of 1.91x. Those after‑loss trades produced a loss of ₹1,95,375 and a win rate of 28% versus 39% on other trades.
size_up_after_loss.rule: After a loss, your next entry stays at your usual size — about ₹6,600. If you want to size up, it has to be a separate decision made before the session, not after a loss.

averaging_down.note: Adding to losing positions is emerging and should be monitored.

closing: Consider applying the rule about keeping your entry size steady after a loss for the next window.
